# Penn State University

> > Penn State is a land-grant research university offering 275+ undergraduate and 300+ graduate programs across 16 colleges, with comprehensive resources including University Libraries, AI education initiatives, and multi-campus system.

The Pennsylvania State University serves students across University Park, World Campus, and regional campuses, with specialized colleges including Agricultural Sciences, Eberly College of Science, College of Medicine, and Penn State Dickinson Law. The university provides extensive academic support through its Libraries system, financial aid resources, and emerging AI education programs.

## University Overview

- [The Pennsylvania State University | Penn State](https://psu.edu): University homepage featuring academics, research, and campus life
- [About Penn State | Penn State](https://psu.edu/about): University mission, rankings, leadership, and land-grant heritage
- [Penn State Mission and Values | Penn State](https://psu.edu/about/mission-and-values): Land-grant mission statement and institutional values
- [Our History | Penn State](https://psu.edu/about/history): University history from 1855 agricultural college to modern institution
- [University Leadership | Penn State](https://psu.edu/about/leadership): President's Council, Board of Trustees, and executive administration

## Academics and Degree Programs

- [Academics | Penn State Degrees | Penn State](https://psu.edu/academics): Overview of 275+ undergraduate and 300+ graduate degree programs
- [Penn State Admissions | College Admissions | Penn State](https://psu.edu/admission): Undergraduate, graduate, and professional admissions overview
- [Undergraduate Majors | Penn State](https://psu.edu/academics/undergraduate/majors): Browse 275+ undergraduate majors across multiple campuses
- [Graduate Degree Programs | Professional Degrees | Penn State](https://psu.edu/academics/graduate): Fox Graduate School, law, and medical school programs overview
- [Academic Colleges | Penn State](https://psu.edu/academics/colleges): Directory of 16 academic colleges including Agricultural Sciences and IST
- [About — Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences](https://agsci.psu.edu/about): College overview, leadership, and land-grant agricultural heritage
- [About the Penn State Eberly College of Science | Eberly College of Science](https://science.psu.edu/about): Eberly College overview covering biological, physical, and math sciences

## Library Resources and Research Guides

- [Penn State University Libraries](https://libraries.psu.edu): Main library homepage with catalog search and subject librarian directory
- [Library Guides | Penn State University Libraries](https://libraries.psu.edu/guides): Subject, course, and how-to guides created by library subject experts
- [How To Guides | Penn State University Libraries](https://libraries.psu.edu/guides/howto): Citation guides, EndNote, data management, and generative AI tutorials
- [In-text Citation - APA Quick Citation Guide - Library Guides at Penn State University](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/apaquickguide/intext): APA Style 7th edition in-text citation guide
- [Resources for Instructors - Generative AI - Library Guides at Penn State University](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/GenAI/instruct): Generative AI concepts for teaching, learning, and research
- [Info for Instructors, Designers, & Librarians - Information Literacy Tutorial (Credo) - Library Guides at Penn State University](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/InformationLiteracyTutorial): Credo information literacy modules for instructors and librarians

## AI Education and Innovation

- [Education - Official Site of the Penn State AI Hub](https://ai.psu.edu/ai-education): AI education programs including Nittany AI Alliance and ChatGPT tutorials

## Student Resources and Support

- [Costs and Aid | Penn State](https://studentaid.psu.edu): Financial aid, tuition costs, and college cost calculators
- [Resources | Knowledge Base | Penn State](https://psu.edu/resources): Admissions and student aid resources for all applicant types
- [Frequently Asked Questions | FAQ | Penn State](https://psu.edu/resources/faq): Undergraduate admissions and financial aid FAQ
- [FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Office of the Bursar](https://bursar.psu.edu/faq): Bursar FAQ covering billing, payments, and student accounts
